aboutPage.title: About PharmaPath & Core Objectives
aboutPage.aimText: PharmaPath empowers undergraduate pharmacy students with structured access to field-training opportunities across four sectors, supported by a simplified educational drug-information assistant linked to verified clinical references.
objectives: Organize training opportunities across community pharmacies, hospitals, companies, and manufacturing plants in a clear format.
Provide smart filtering by city, training sector, available dates, working hours, and professional interest.
Offer an AI-assisted educational chatbot that explains drug concepts simply and directs students to reliable sources.
Connect academic pharmacology coursework with real-world clinical and industrial practice.
aboutPage.sectorsSubheading: PharmaPath covers all four primary field-training pathways to give students a complete practical perspective:
aboutPage.privacyNoteText: All training listings currently displayed are clearly marked educational samples, and student inquiries are never shared with third parties.
